lines.trans: Sometimes we need to make difficult decisions.
To fight for our love or give up.
Or simply look for a new goal.
And everything depends on this decision.
Our Kuzma just kicked me.
What, where is he right now?
Actually, Kuzma is our future son.
I do not understand, why Kuzma specifically?
What, you do not like Kuzma either?
Kostya, there is no pleasing you at all.
Nastya, because those are strange names.
And everyone will tease our son.

examples.text: Ведь мы с тобой должны быть вместе.
examples.trans: After all, you and I must be together.

examples.text: Должен же быть какой-то хороший вариант.
examples.trans: There must be some good option.

examples.text: Потому что твой телефон должен быть в руках!
examples.trans: Because your phone must be in your hands!
